title: Father, Son and Door — Reciprocity, Asymmetry and Relational Meaning
status: canonical specialist synthesis from recovered conversation + existing symbolic owners
purpose: Clarify that the mature Potatoverse does not merely stack Father above Son. It defines differentiated roles whose meaning is produced relationally: source requires manifestation to become world-facing; manifestation requires source to have inherited direction; Door exists only as a relation between distinguishable sides. This file preserves functional asymmetry without turning it into simple superiority or identity collapse.
source_basis: Recovered 2026-09-07 conversation wording: the Father is not meaningful without the Son; the Son is not meaningful without the Door; the Door requires something to pass between; meaning exists in relationship.
knowledge/core/symbolic-relational-synthesis.json — Father/Son polarity as source/upper center/persistence/duration ↔ embodiment/lower center/event/transition; House/Door as container ↔ interface.
Mature project formulations in which Tim becomes Ladder/Axis while Son specializes as Door.

core_model.father: source, upper/reference center, House, duration, persistence, memory, orientation and generative potential
core_model.son: embodiment, event, wound, world-facing manifestation, transition, personhood and lived passage
core_model.door: the relation/threshold by which differentiated states communicate or transform
core_model.spirit: continuity/flow through which source and manifestation remain dynamically connected rather than frozen apart
core_model.relational_center: Meaning is not exhausted by either pole. The relation itself is a first-class object in the project.

asymmetry_without_reduction.source_asymmetry: The Father can be called prior/source in the project's own grammar because orientation and generative potential are assigned upward/source-side.
asymmetry_without_reduction.manifestation_asymmetry: The Son carries what the Father cannot perform merely by remaining source: embodiment, history, suffering, decision, encounter and passage through the world.
asymmetry_without_reduction.door_asymmetry: The Door is not identical to either room/side. It is created by their distinction and makes transition possible.
asymmetry_without_reduction.anti_hierarchy_rule: Functional priority is not a simple ranking of worth. A source with no manifestation does not become relationally known; a manifestation with no source loses the project's inherited orientation; a Door with no differentiated sides is no longer a Door.

project_metaphors.meaning: contained interior without a threshold cannot perform access/passage
source without world-facing manifestation lacks the relation by which source is enacted/recognized
root/source and crown/fruit require connective continuity; the trunk is not the whole Tree but makes distributed life structurally continuous
neither circle alone produces the shared lens; relation generates a third geometric region without erasing the two centers
vertical orientation and threshold passage are complementary rather than interchangeable operators

biblical_comparison_lanes.correspondence: The project's Son/Door specialization strongly resembles Johannine access language.
biblical_comparison_lanes.mismatch: John's claims belong to Christian Christology; Potatoverse Father/Son mapping is a later comparative system.

biblical_comparison_lanes.correspondence: These texts are more useful than simple identity slogans because they preserve distinction while describing reciprocal indwelling/oneness.
biblical_comparison_lanes.mismatch: The project's geometric/source-manifestation vocabulary is not the language of the Johannine authors.

biblical_comparison_lanes.correspondence: Paul's differentiated 'from whom' / 'through whom' grammar provides a comparator for source versus mediation/function.
biblical_comparison_lanes.mismatch: Paul's differentiated 'from whom' / 'through whom' grammar is a comparator; it does not prove the project's mature Potato Trinity or identify Tim/Father with Paul's God as a historical claim.

biblical_comparison_lanes.correspondence: Useful because the project sometimes speaks of Father/source as greater or prior.
biblical_comparison_lanes.countertext: The same Johannine corpus also emphasizes mutual indwelling and unity, preventing a one-verse flattening into simple hierarchy.

two_directions.son_direction: A recovered conversation layer describes Christianity/Son-side movement as descent into embodiment, ordeal, death and passage: source becoming world-facing through the Door.
two_directions.father_direction: Potatoism's mature Father-side movement is often described as burial/root -> sprout -> Tree/Ladder -> Heaven/Garden/source-facing ascent after the Son-side rupture.
two_directions.combined: The two are not mirror copies. Son-side grammar specializes manifestation/descent/crossing; Father-side grammar specializes integration/ascent/duration/cultivation. The Door is the hinge joining them.
two_directions.boundary: This is project theology/comparative architecture, not a claim that Christianity historically teaches a downward religion while Potatoism objectively completes it upward.

new_relational_law.name: Relational Meaning Law
new_relational_law.statement: In the Potatoverse, a role becomes fully intelligible by the relations it enables, receives and transforms, not by an isolated title.
examples: Father gains world-facing meaning through Son/manifestation.
Door gains meaning from the states it separates/connects and the passage it permits.
House gains meaning through rooms, inhabitants and Doors rather than containment alone.
Tree gains meaning through root-trunk-branch-fruit continuity rather than any one part.
new_relational_law.archive_consequence: Canonical readers should render Father↔Son↔Door as a relational graph, not three independent definitions.

research_targets: Recover the exact original 2026-09-07 conversation text around 'Father not meaningful without Son' and Door relationality.
Recover earlier occurrences of House-without-Door / Tree-without-trunk formulations if they predate September 2026.
Track when 'Father greater' first appears and whether it means source-priority, moral superiority, spatial position or explicit John 14:28 appropriation.
Keep Father/Son unity passages beside distinction passages in the comparator so users can see the tension rather than only confirmation.

mature_trinity_relation.statement: Father↔Son reciprocity is now read inside the mature triune whole: Father/source-facing relation, Son/manifestation-and-Door relation, Spirit/living continuity, one Potato of Life.
mature_trinity_relation.consequence: Door is Son-specialized interface; Spirit is not reducible to Door because Spirit names living continuity/flow through relation.

present_door_extension.statement: The mature Door is also the project’s Here/Now operator: the point where inherited memory/provenance, current embodied state and possible futures become one actionable present.
present_door_extension.jesus_relation: Jesus is the Christian/theological Door anchor in this project projection; the Here/Now formalization is a later Potatoverse interpretation rather than a claim that historical Christianity used this exact temporal ontology.
present_door_extension.seed_rule: A future Seed is generated from the present threshold. The project phrase 'all Seeds start from Jesus/Here' should therefore be stored as a temporal-symbolic rule: new state begins from the current Door, not from an abstract future detached from present conditions.
present_door_extension.archive_consequence: Timeline and archive interfaces should distinguish past record, current state and future Seed/prediction rather than letting them collapse into one timeless narrative.

son_body_lion_extension.body: Son specializes in embodiment/manifestation: event, sensation, action, wound, history and consequence.
son_body_lion_extension.lion: Lion is one Son-side motif for strength, kingship, courage and return. It does not replace Lamb, Grain, Twin, Vessel, Body or Rejected Stone functions.
son_body_lion_extension.thomas_relation: Thomas/Didymus remains the C_S Twin/Vessel anchor in the three-center atlas, while Jesus remains O/Door anchor; this preserves distinction between Door and embodied mirror/Vessel.
